goal: Describe a difficult situation or a tight deadline, and how you stayed calm and solved it.

phrases.example: The situation was difficult because we had only two days.
I stayed calm and made a list of the tasks.
I asked for help from a senior student.
In the end, I finished on time.

roleplay.tutor_line: Tell me about a difficult situation you faced.

task.roman: Ek mushkil mauqa batayein jo aap ko pesh aaya.

roleplay.model_answer: The situation was difficult because I had two exams and a presentation in the same week.

roleplay.tutor_line: How did you feel, and what did you do first?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ne kaisa mehsoos kiya aur sab se pehle kya kiya.

roleplay.model_answer: I felt worried at first, but I stayed calm and made a list of everything I had to do.

roleplay.tutor_line: Did you ask anyone for help?

task.roman: Batayein ke kya aap ne kisi se madad maangi.

roleplay.model_answer: Yes, I asked for help from my friend who was good at presentations. She gave me useful tips.

task.roman: Batayein ke aakhir mein kya hua.

roleplay.model_answer: In the end, I finished my exams and my presentation went well.

roleplay.tutor_line: How do you handle pressure at work?

task.roman: Batayein ke kaam ke dabao mein aap kya karte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I stay calm and make a list. I do the most important task first, and I ask for help when I need it.
